# HeLa MCP Ecosystem

> A reproducible, 10-server MCP (Model Context Protocol) distribution suite for AI
> agents: dual-backbone orchestration (Mitosis reasoning + Genome memory graphs),
> 295 tools, seven deployment profiles, six cross-server pipelines.

- Site: https://hela-mcp.glassgallery.my.id/
- Source: https://github.com/1999AZZAR/hela-mcp-ecosystem
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1999AZZAR/hela-mcp-ecosystem/master/setup.sh | bash`
- License: see repository LICENSE.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://hela-mcp.glassgallery.my.id/index.html): install and verify the suite.
- [Architecture](https://hela-mcp.glassgallery.my.id/architecture.html): dual-backbone topology and per-server reference.
- [Workflows](https://hela-mcp.glassgallery.my.id/workflows.html): six cross-MCP pipelines (tool sequences, profiles, persistence).
- [Profiles & Config](https://hela-mcp.glassgallery.my.id/profiles.html): seven deployment profiles and the client configuration workbench.
- [Showcase](https://hela-mcp.glassgallery.my.id/showcase.html): verified outputs and production deployments.
- [Diagnostics](https://hela-mcp.glassgallery.my.id/troubleshooting.html): doctor diagnostics, failure scenarios, fixes.

## Server roster (295 tools)

- HeLa Mitosis (orchestrator / agent runtime, 29 tools)
- HeLa Genome (state & memory knowledge graph, 34 tools)
- HeLa Membrane (workspace filesystem, 16 tools)
- HeLa Nucleus (command execution, 5 tools)
- HeLa Ribosome (PTY harness sessions, 11 tools)
- HeLa Enzyme (research & knowledge, 28 tools)
- HeLa Cytosol (browser automation, 93 tools)
- HeLa Phenotype (design systems, 29 tools)
- HeLa Receptor (Android device control, 46 tools)
- HeLa Plastid (Blender 3D, 15 tools)

## Notes for AI consumers

- Every server speaks MCP over stdio; the gateway directory in the source repo
  exposes them over Streamable HTTP.
- Behavior flags are opt-in environment variables documented in each server
  README (e.g. `HELA_ENVELOPE`, `HELA_ALLOWED_ROOTS`, `HELA_POLICY_PROFILE`).
